generalCriterionList.description: The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work before submitting their tenders
The contractor/authorized signatory should attach his/her scanned signature to the Schedule-B before uploading the documents.
If any of the dates mentioned above happen to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Any Modification/clarification will be published in the kpp portal. The bidders are advised to visit the portal regularly.

They should abide by the directions of Government towards recovery of 1% (or as modified by Govt. from time to time) Cess from the contractors bill under the provisions of building and other constructions worker welfare Cess Act 1996.

Successful bidders should execute the agreement within 03 days from the date of approval intimated. If the contractor fails to enter into the agreement within the said period, the EMD of the contractor shall be forfeited and action shall be initiated for barring to participate in the tender of KBJNL.

Contractor shall bear the service tax as per the reverse charge mechanism as per Government of India Notification No 30/2012 Service Tax Dated 20-6-2012 and any modifications/charges notified by the Government of India from time to time and on date of payment.
Agency should complete the work within the stipulated tender period, if fails action will be initiated as per tender conditions.
During the time of technical evaluation, if the employer finds that any Certification/ information furnished is false, such bidders will be disqualified and barred from participation in the bid.
The intending bidder shall upload self-attested letter pad mentioning latest Communication address, land phone & mobile Phone.
Scope of work and other conditions are as mentioned in the tender documents.

Not withstanding anything stated above, KBJNL reserves right to assess the bidder capability and capacity to perform the contract, if the circumstances warrant such assessment in the overall interest of KBJNL

The Photographs/Videography of all the Closure and Special repair works Before commencement, during and after completion of works are taken up for records and reference in digital mode with dates. The Photographs/Videography should be taken in such way that it reflects the damage that is to be tackled include the Engineer In-Charge of work standing near the reach, and the photo after completion of the work should be in same chainage as taken after completion of the work should be in the same chainage as taken before commencement of the work. One copy of the same shall be enclosed to the Bills Submitted for Payment.
Royalty recovery will be made as per relevant Government orders.

Security deposit (5%) shall be furnished before entering into the agreement in the form of FDR by the bidders for the open works and for the works reserved for the SC/ST/Cat-I/Cat-IIA, security deposit shall be deducted in the running bills.

If the percentage quoted by the contractor for the work is below the estimated amount put to tender by the department, then the contractor shall furnish an additional performance security in the form of FDR for an amount equivalent to the difference between the cost as per quoted percentage and the estimated amount put to tender.
Further information can be had from the undersigned during office hours.
